items.why: Same formula, same DB2 columns, both read wago.tools rows as string dicts. Differences: project bounds-checks (point inside the Region box, a non-degenerate region, result in 0..1) and returns None otherwise; map_position extrapolates without checks. That difference would need checking for walk points just outside the zone rect (Path.FindSync may step off the uiMap rect), so a switch must handle None. world_point (1003-1011) is the inverse and has no counterpart in gen_quests. The docstring says the math inverts 'SPF's projection', a third copy in another repo.
items.reason: The contracts differ: map_position selects a row for a 2-D point and extrapolates, raising on degenerate spans, whereas project accepts a supplied row and altitude and returns None for out-of-region, degenerate or off-map points. Pinned SPF 061f0b1 Route.lua:88-118 preserves off-map endpoints for segment clipping, AGF map_frame clips after drawing, and a cached Barrens-row probe produced (-0.1, 0.5) versus None, establishing a rendering constraint that requires this divergence.
